utf8:
name: Rust workspace

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  cpu:
    name: CPU / ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Install pinned compiler and review tools
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
      - name: Fetch checksum-pinned reviewed dependencies
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: Debug tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline --locked
      - name: Release tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-targets --release --offline --locked
      - name: Strict Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline --locked -- -D warnings
      - name: Source and dependency audit
        run: cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask -- audit
      - name: Windows system math file identity
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask -- hash "$env:SystemRoot\System32\ucrtbase.dll"
      - name: GNU system math file identity
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask -- hash /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.so.6
      - name: Independent fixture integrity
        run: cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask -- fixtures
      - name: Release build
        run: cargo build --workspace --release --offline --locked
      - name: Fetch pinned F32 model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/stories260K.gguf" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models-moved/resolve/main/tinyllamas/stories260K.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned Q4 model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/stories15M-q4_0.gguf" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models-moved/resolve/main/tinyllamas/stories15M-q4_0.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned BERT model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/bert-bge-small-f16.gguf" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models-moved/resolve/main/bert-bge-small/ggml-model-f16.gguf
      - name: Fetch equivalent big-endian BERT model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/bert-bge-small-f16-big-endian.gguf" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models-moved/resolve/main/bert-bge-small/ggml-model-f16-big-endian.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned BPE Q4_K model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/SmolLM2-135M-Q4_K_M.gguf" https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/SmolLM2-135M-GGUF/resolve/main/SmolLM2-135M-Q4_K_M.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned Mamba recurrent model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/mamba-130m-hf.f16.gguf" https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/mamba-130m-hf-GGUF/resolve/ecd441bd76c60ebf9c3e71bfc3f83ba64fa1edd1/mamba-130m-hf.f16.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned Qwen2 Q4_K model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf" https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-GGUF/resolve/9217f5db79a29953eb74d5343926648285ec7e67/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf
      - name: Fetch pinned Qwen3 Q8 model data
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/qwen3-0.6b-q8_0.gguf" https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/resolve/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf
      - name: Fetch exact official GPT2 checkpoint for Rust fixture preparation
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --max-time 600 --max-filesize 548105171 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/gpt2-original.safetensors" https://huggingface.co/openai-community/gpt2/resolve/607a30d783dfa663caf39e06633721c8d4cfcd7e/model.safetensors
      - name: Fetch exact official Pythia checkpoint for Rust fixture preparation
        run: curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --max-time 600 --max-filesize 28143920 --output "${{ runner.temp }}/pythia-14m-original.safetensors" https://huggingface.co/EleutherAI/pythia-14m/resolve/cf967c0a9a04383db6f7b1108d86b2962634b4ac/model.safetensors
      - name: Prepare exact GPT2 GGUF with native Rust and verified hashes
        run: cargo run --release --offline --locked -p xtask -- prepare-pretrained-fixture gpt2-124m-f16 "${{ runner.temp }}/gpt2-original.safetensors" "${{ runner.temp }}/gpt2-124m-f16.gguf"
      - name: Prepare exact Pythia GGUF with native Rust and verified hashes
        run: cargo run --release --offline --locked -p xtask -- prepare-pretrained-fixture pythia-14m-f16 "${{ runner.temp }}/pythia-14m-original.safetensors" "${{ runner.temp }}/pythia-14m-f16.gguf"
      - name: Pretrained model comparisons with verified SHA-256 inputs
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_GPT2_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/gpt2-124m-f16.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_GPTNEOX_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/pythia-14m-f16.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/stories260K.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_Q4_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/stories15M-q4_0.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_BPE_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/SmolLM2-135M-Q4_K_M.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_MAMBA_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/mamba-130m-hf.f16.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN2_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN3_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen3-0.6b-q8_0.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_BERT_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/bert-bge-small-f16.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_BERT_BE_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/bert-bge-small-f16-big-endian.gguf
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-inference -p llama-server --tests -- --ignored --nocapture --skip official_bloom_560m

      - name: Pretrained native C encoder comparisons
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_BERT_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/bert-bge-small-f16.gguf
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-ffi context::encoder::tests::independent_pretrained_native_bert_encoder_corpus -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

  # Each model gets a fresh runner: its checkpoint and three complete outputs
  # remain separate from the inference cache and the other converter model.
  qwen-conversion:
    name: Qwen conversion / ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.model.name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        model:
          - name: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
            test: pretrained_qwen2_native_files
          - name: Qwen3-0.6B
            test: pretrained_qwen3_native_files
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: '1'
      QWEN_MODEL: ${{ matrix.model.name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Install pinned compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal
      - name: Fetch checksum-pinned reviewed dependencies
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch and verify unchanged official Qwen inputs
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN_HF_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-hf
        run: |
          $manifest = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'crates/convert/tests/fixtures/qwen-conversion/pretrained-reference.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
          $selected = @($manifest.models | Where-Object { $_.name -eq $env:QWEN_MODEL })
          if ($selected.Count -ne 1) { throw "Expected one pinned model named $env:QWEN_MODEL" }
          foreach ($model in $manifest.models) {
            # The complete-file test needs all eight inputs for this matrix model.
            # Both small tokenizer JSONs also support the official tokenizer replay.
            $files = if ($model.name -eq $env:QWEN_MODEL) {
              @($model.inputs)
            } else {
              @($model.inputs | Where-Object { $_.path -eq 'tokenizer.json' })
            }
            foreach ($file in $files) {
              $directory = Join-Path $env:LLAMA_TEST_QWEN_HF_ROOT $model.name
              $destination = Join-Path $directory $file.path
              $url = "https://huggingface.co/$($model.repository)/resolve/$($model.revision)/$($file.path)"
              # Redirect bodies can exceed tiny targets; final length and SHA-256 stay exact.
              $maximumTransferBytes = [Math]::Max([long]$file.bytes, [long]1048576)
              & curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --max-time 900 --max-filesize $maximumTransferBytes --create-dirs --output $destination $url
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Download failed: $($model.name)/$($file.path)" }
              if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $destination).Length -ne $file.bytes) {
                throw "Length mismatch: $($model.name)/$($file.path)"
              }
              $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $destination -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
              if ($hash -cne $file.sha256) { throw "SHA-256 mismatch: $($model.name)/$($file.path)" }
              Write-Host "Verified $($model.name)/$($file.path): $($file.bytes) bytes, SHA-256 $hash"
            }
          }
      - name: Replay official Qwen tokenizer references
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN_TOKENIZER_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-hf
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-convert --lib pretrained_qwen_tokenizer_reference -- --ignored --nocapture
      - name: Compare all three complete GGUF files with the frozen converter
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN_HF_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-hf
          LLAMA_TEST_QWEN_OUTPUT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/qwen-converter-output
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-convert --test qwen_pretrained ${{ matrix.model.test }} -- --ignored --exact --nocapture

  gpt-conversion:
    name: GPT conversion / ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Install pinned compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal
      - name: Fetch checksum-pinned reviewed dependencies
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch and verify unchanged official GPT inputs
        env:
          GPT_CHECKPOINT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/gpt-converter-inputs
        run: |
          $manifest = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'crates/convert/tests/fixtures/gpt-conversion/pretrained-reference.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
          foreach ($modelKey in @('gpt2', 'gptneox')) {
            $origin = $manifest.model_origins.$modelKey
            $directory = Join-Path (Join-Path $env:GPT_CHECKPOINT_ROOT $modelKey) 'official-hf'
            foreach ($file in $origin.files) {
              $destination = Join-Path $directory $file.path
              # Redirect responses can be larger than the small final sidecar.
              $maximumTransferBytes = [Math]::Max([long]$file.bytes, [long]1048576)
              & curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --max-time 900 --max-filesize $maximumTransferBytes --create-dirs --output $destination $file.url
              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Download failed: $modelKey/$($file.path)" }
              if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $destination).Length -ne $file.bytes) {
                throw "Length mismatch: $modelKey/$($file.path)"
              }
              $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $destination -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
              if ($hash -cne $file.sha256) { throw "SHA-256 mismatch: $modelKey/$($file.path)" }
              Write-Host "Verified $modelKey/$($file.path): $($file.bytes) bytes, SHA-256 $hash"
            }
          }
      - name: Compare complete GPT conversions and the original GPT-2 rejection
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_GPT2_HF: ${{ runner.temp }}/gpt-converter-inputs/gpt2/official-hf
          LLAMA_TEST_GPTNEOX_HF: ${{ runner.temp }}/gpt-converter-inputs/gptneox/official-hf
          LLAMA_TEST_GPT_OUTPUT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/gpt-converter-output
        run: cargo test -p llama-convert --release --offline --locked --test gpt_pretrained -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

  # BLOOM conversion retains its exact F16/Q8_0 outputs for the inference replay.
  # The CPU job's explicit skip is covered here on each corresponding host.
  bloom-conversion-inference:
    name: BLOOM conversion and inference / ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: '2'
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Install pinned compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.99.1 --profile minimal
      - name: Fetch checksum-pinned reviewed dependencies
        run: cargo fetch --locked
      - name: Fetch and verify unchanged official BLOOM inputs
        env:
          BLOOM_CHECKPOINT: ${{ runner.temp }}/bloom-hf/official-hf
        run: |
          $manifest = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'crates/convert/tests/fixtures/bloom-conversion/pretrained-reference.json' | ConvertFrom-Json
          foreach ($file in $manifest.model_origin.files) {
            $destination = Join-Path $env:BLOOM_CHECKPOINT $file.path
            $maximumTransferBytes = [Math]::Max([long]$file.bytes, [long]1048576)
            & curl --fail --location --ipv4 --retry 3 --max-time 900 --max-filesize $maximumTransferBytes --create-dirs --output $destination $file.url
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Download failed: BLOOM/$($file.path)" }
            if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $destination).Length -ne $file.bytes) {
              throw "Length mismatch: BLOOM/$($file.path)"
            }
            $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $destination -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            if ($hash -cne $file.sha256) { throw "SHA-256 mismatch: BLOOM/$($file.path)" }
            Write-Host "Verified BLOOM/$($file.path): $($file.bytes) bytes, SHA-256 $hash"
          }
      - name: Compare all three complete BLOOM conversions with the frozen converter
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_BLOOM_HF: ${{ runner.temp }}/bloom-hf/official-hf
          LLAMA_TEST_BLOOM_OUTPUT_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/bloom-converter-output
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-convert --test bloom_pretrained -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
      - name: Replay F16 and Q8_0 BLOOM inference against frozen native outputs
        env:
          LLAMA_TEST_BLOOM_F16_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/bloom-converter-output/bloom-560m/f16.gguf
          LLAMA_TEST_BLOOM_Q8_0_MODEL: ${{ runner.temp }}/bloom-converter-output/bloom-560m/q8_0.gguf
        run: cargo test --release --offline --locked -p llama-inference --test bloom official_bloom_560m -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
